caseNameFull: Moyer v. Hines, Administrator of Veterans' Affairs
attorneys: Mr. Thomas H. Sutherland for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Paul A. Sweeney for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma’pauperis, denied.
